label: Diagram 23
caption: Diagram 23  Foundation dimensions
description: This is a cross-section drawing titled "Diagram 23 Foundation dimensions", with the note "See para 2E2c" at the top left. The central image shows vertical lines representing a wall sitting centrally on a wider horizontal rectangular foundation. Above the wall, dimension lines with tick marks divide the width into three segments labelled, from left to right, "P", "W", and "P", where W spans the wall and the two P segments span the foundation overhangs on each side; the caption above reads "Wall should be central on foundation". To the left of the foundation, a vertical dimension line labelled "T" indicates its thickness, and the text states: "The minimum thickness of the foundation (T) should either be P or 150mm, whichever is greater." Below the foundation, a horizontal dimension line spans its full width, captioned "Foundation width should be not less than the appropriate dimension in Table 10". A note at the bottom reads: "Trench fill foundations may be used as an alternative to strip foundations."
